spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very hot or acrid.
m. (-रः)
1 Iron armour, for the defence of a horse or elephant.
2 A dog.
3 A mule.
E.
प्र very much, खन to hurt, aff. रक, deriv. irr.; or प्र before खर an ass, or hot, sharp, &c.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
Like, resembling, (in composition.)
E.
प्र before ख्या to say, aff. ड.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Celebrated, famous, notorious.
2 Pleased, happy.
3 Bespoken, forestalled, claimed by right of preemption.
E.
प्र much, ख्यात famed.

n. (-ण्डं)
A commodity that is to be first offered for sale to some person, (as the Raja, &c.)
E.
प्रख्यात claimed, भाण्ड a vessel.

m. (-कः)
A gentleman, a Hidalgo, the son of some body.
E.
प्रख्यात known, वप्तृ a father, and कन् added.

f. (-तिः)
1 Publicity, notoriety.
2 Praise, eulogium.
3 Fame.
E.
प्र pre-eminence, &c. and ख्याति reputation.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be celebrated or made known.
E.
प्र before ख्या to say, अनीयर् aff.

Wickedness.
E.
प्रखर, and ष्यञ् aff.
